[[Molachev]] is planning an uprising and [[Krak Flamewhip]] wants you to deal with him.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
* [[Summit Slaves]] active in quest log.

===Objectives===
* Defeat Molachev
* See Krak Flamewhip for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,500 [[Experience]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Krak Flamewhip'''
:''"Listen, slave. The [[Dredge]] are planning something...they think to stage an uprising, or some such. Molachev's looking for a fight, and I'm about to send him one. Kill him, and I'll reward ye."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Your wish is my command.
| decline = You've got the wrong slave.
| ask = What're you doing lazing about here? I sent you to kill Molachev! Get moving!
}}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Krak Flamewhip'''
:''"Good job, slave. Now get back to work."''

==Notes==
* The Stone Basilica can be scouted for [[Summit Slaves]] on the way to Molachev.
* Darkhaven can be scouted for [[Summit Slaves]] while fighting Molachev.
** The ally and enemy Dredge in Darkhaven are hostile to each other.
